Name: MouseyPounds' Bears in the Barn for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
Permissions are open for both MouseyPounds' version and MS_Paintdra's version, so I present BFAV Bears in the Barn (found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4000]here[/url]) for SDV 1.6. Original artwork by MSPaintdra (found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2695]here[/url]).

Bears live in the barns and produce:

Brown Bears: Salmon and Sturgeon
Black Bears: Rainbow Trout and Tiger Trout﻿
Polar Bears: Crab and Lobster
Pandas: Sea Cucumber and Super Cucumber﻿

All credit for the original work goes to MouseyPounds and MS_Paintdra

Enjoy!
